findings.title: Missing VOC Content Info
findings.detail: VOC lower than SCAQMD 1168 requires (250 g/L: the Rule 1168 architectural sealant limit; the number comes from the rule, not the spec).
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed low VOC levels, we can’t ensure indoor air quality meets health standards during occupancy.

findings.title: Missing Mold Resistance Rating
findings.detail: Firestopping materials shall have mold and mildew resistance rating of zero(0) in accordance with ASTM G21.
findings.why_it_matters: Lack of mold resistance proof risks long-term performance in damp areas where sealants are exposed.

findings.title: Assembly Rating Needs Verification
findings.detail: Product data does not establish a specific assembly's F/T ratings. Confirm the listed assembly separately.
findings.why_it_matters: We must verify the actual fire and temperature rating of the installed assembly to confirm it will protect life safety in a fire event.

findings.title: Missing Test Standard Proof
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: If the product wasn’t tested to the right standard, we can’t trust it will stop fire spread through penetrations as required.

findings.title: Outdated Product Data Sheet
findings.detail: The submitted sheet (None) differs from the current one (None) on: Pipe types covered, Highest service temperature.
findings.why_it_matters: An outdated data sheet may not reflect current capabilities—using it could mean installing a product that doesn’t meet today’s project needs.
